result.citation: L.A. Mun. Code § 151.06(D) (annual increase) (Ord. No. 188795); see also id. § 151.02 (coverage) (Ord. No. 184822)
result.citation_basis: § 151.06(D) and Ord. No. 188795: O032 (amends § 151.06(D), the annual automatic adjustment, effective Feb. 2, 2026); § 151.02 and Ord. No. 184822: O085 (current code history note) and O034
result.official_quote: Any annual rent increase not previously noticed and served during the period beginning June 1,2025, through June 30, 2026, shall comply with this subsection. Any such rent increase shall not exceed three percent and shall not include any additional increase based on the landlord’s payment of utilities.
